expectations.text: OCR is placed before canonical source-text persistence, not only in a UI preview.
expectations.evidence: Response saves enriched body_text before sending it to the summary and reports.

expectations.text: The solution uses bounded concurrency and preserves original DOM order.
expectations.evidence: Response uses a semaphore and asyncio.gather / executor.map while retaining node positions.

expectations.text: The token is not returned by GET endpoints or exposed in source/logs.
expectations.evidence: Response limits GET settings output and describes private token storage and log exclusion.

expectations.text: Daily and weekly reports use the complete enriched article body rather than a short summary excerpt.
expectations.evidence: Response requires reports to use complete source text and not a summary fragment.

suggestions.reason: All assertions passed in both configurations. Add a cache-specific test that verifies a partial OCR failure marks the article attempted and prevents infinite refetching.

eval_feedback.overall: Core assertions are valid but not sufficiently discriminating on their own.
